current.text: He is most likely Miami's sixth man and should get the most bench minutes. Tim Hardaway Jr. and Bobby Portis are also candidates for that role.
He could be the backup point guard or even the starter. Josh would start him. If he wins the starting job, draft him.

Hardaway, Klay Thompson, Davion Mitchell and Portis all compete for his minutes. That makes it unlikely he gets enough minutes and usage, and the Thompson signing in particular lowers his minutes upside.
Miami has not decided whether to start a traditional point guard or let Giannis Antetokounmpo run the offense. Davion Mitchell is the projected starter at point guard, but he may not close games.
Yahoo's rank feels a little high. ESPN does not rank him, and his Fantrax ADP is 178. He is fine as a last-round flyer or a late swing.
His assist conversion rate was high and could fall to about 50%, which would make his numbers look worse.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an illness.

With the March 28 end, Miami has a weak 4-3-3 schedule in our playoff weeks, 10 games in total, with no back-to-backs in those weeks. Over the full season Miami has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.

durable.text: He has not shown he can shoot threes: 32% on under 3 attempts a game.
His overall shooting is efficient at about 50% from the field. He gets few steals and takes few free throws.
He can play as a pseudo point guard. Last season he had stretches in that role with about five assists a game.

note: Yahoo ranks him 153 with a value of 0 USD and ESPN does not rank him, so he sits just outside our 144 drafted players. At most he is a 1 USD last-round flyer. His projection has no category above the pool except a small plus in FG% (49.1% on 8.2 attempts) and low turnovers, so his value depends on role. Check the preseason starting lineup: if he starts at point guard ahead of Mitchell, take him late or grab him early on waivers. If he comes off the bench behind Hardaway, Thompson and Portis, leave him on waivers, especially since Miami has only 10 games in our playoff weeks.
